summary: Giving yourself an item with a Wind Burst enchantment level higher than 3, then hitting certain entities crashes the game
description: The bug Hitting certain entities (boats, end crystals, fireballs, players, minecarts, shulker bullets and wind charges) with an item enchanted with a Wind Burst level greater than 4 crashes the game. How to reproduce - Enter the following command in the chat: /give @s mace[minecraft:enchantments={levels:{ wind_burst :4}}] - Hit one of the mentioned entities with the mace (it will work with any item)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Enter the following command in the chat: `/give @s mace[minecraft:enchantments={levels:{ wind_burst :4}}]`
3. Find one of the mentioned entities (boats, end crystals, fireballs, players, minecarts, shulker bullets, or wind charges).
4. Hit the entity with the enchanted mace.
5. Observe that the game crashes after hitting the entity.
Observed Behavior: When an item enchanted with a Wind Burst level greater than 4 is used to hit certain entities such as boats, end crystals, fireballs, players, minecarts, shulker bullets, and wind charges, the game crashes. To reproduce this issue, enter the command `/give @s mace[minecraft:enchantments={levels:{wind_burst:4}}]` in the chat to obtain a mace with Wind Burst level 4. Then, hit one of the mentioned entities with the mace; the crash will occur regardless of whether any item other than the mace is used for the attack. This behavior specifically impacts gameplay and stability when dealing with the specified entities under these conditions.
Expected Behavior: When an item enchanted with a Wind Burst level greater than 4 is used to hit certain entities (boats, end crystals, fireballs, players, minecarts, shulker bullets, and wind charges), the game should apply the intended knockback effect without crashing. The player should be able to perform smash attacks on these entities without encountering any stability issues, ensuring smooth gameplay and consistent behavior across all affected entities.
